title: Procedural instances (Blender)
description: An actual Geometry Nodes graph creates 16, 49 and 100 randomly sized instances. Compare three saved Cycles renders; edit the script or .blend file and rerun to change the graph.

made_with: blender through a bundled, executed recipe
summary: Compare 16, 49 and 100 instances generated by a real Geometry Nodes graph.

try: Edit build.py and rerun the recipe to change the scene
